_about: JLCPCB's manufacturing limits, written into each board's .kicad_dru so KiCad's DRC checks them. Values are millimetres. Edit them when JLCPCB's capabilities page changes. 'cost' lists features JLCPCB makes but charges extra for; the quote adds them as lines.

small_via.note: Vias under 0.3 mm drill are an extra-cost option at JLCPCB.

via_in_pad.note: Vias in pads must be epoxy-filled and capped (POFV). JLCPCB includes it on 6-layer boards and charges for it on 4-layer boards; it is not offered on 1- and 2-layer boards.
